gpu_note: iris/query.py._embed_query uses CUDA when available for CLIP text embedding. This introduces small (~1e-4 magnitude) run-to-run floating-point jitter in retrieval results across separate process invocations (observed and documented in scripts/span_sweep_final.py header). Every number in the final report comes from a single retrieval pass (scripts/span_sweep_final.py), so all within-report comparisons are self-consistent; only the reproduction_gate.json artifact (written by the earlier scripts/span_sweep.py run) is from a separate process, and its match was exact to 8 decimal places, well inside tolerance.
